title: Registry vocabulary, identity and version metadata
summary:
Закрепить типизированную identity каждой extension point, explicit
replacement directives, module version/reference metadata и общий `ExtensionStamp`.
why:
`@plan/knowledge/research-P11-design.json` §2–§3, §5, §8; D56–D57. Текущий
compiler видит имена packages, но теряет version/reference и не имеет
общего словаря identity/replacement.

include:
Additive `Manifest::replace()`; immutable replacement/version/stamp data;
version discovery from Composer metadata; point identity table in extension policy; focused tests.
exclude:
Compile algorithm; cache publication; runtime freeze; durable consumer wiring;
new extension points; public registrar rename from P15.
